capabilities: Arrange a customizable dashboard of resizable cards
Chart word counts, streaks and heatmap activity
List overdue and upcoming tasks from due dates
Report broken links, orphans and unused attachments
Find repeated passages across notes and clean them up
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only lists and counts existing tasks and checkbox due dates.
extras: Local only: no network requests and no data collection. Clicking a tag requires the core Search plugin. Word counts are approximate, and the cumulative word trend uses current counts on creation dates, not history. Writing word counts into properties is off by default and can rewrite the properties block, losing YAML comments.
problem: Obsidian has no single view of vault-wide writing activity, task deadlines, and note health, so these numbers must be gathered by hand.

relations.evidence: This used to be a separate plugin, Clip Dedupe. It is now built into Note Pulse

summary: Dashboard plugin that shows vault writing streaks, word and note trends, task due dates, tag and link statistics, plus vault check-up and duplicate cleanup.
